name: HIS LAST MACHINATION
source:
In a world still scarred by the fading horrors of war, you are a sellsword of ordinary tasks, your specialties bound to many trades and none. Your clientele is diverse; the discreet conveyance of information is your most frequent area of employ.

To that end, they call you "MESSENGER."

A man of great renown seeks reconciliation with his past—a final visitation upon a wound from decades prior, its pain potent enough to persist unto the present. Yet, as you well know...

Even long-sealed scars may yet carry complications.

[From [url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/his-last-machination]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个仍然被战争的恐惧所伤痕累累的世界里，你是一名执行普通任务的雇佣兵，你的专长与许多行业相关，但又没有。你的客户是多元化的；谨慎地传达信息是你最常从事的工作领域。

为此，他们称你为“信使”。

一位享有盛誉的人寻求与他的过去和解——对几十年前的伤口进行最后的探访，其痛苦足以持续至今。然而，正如你所知…

即使是长期封闭的疤痕也可能会带来并发症。

[来自[url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/his-last-machination]itch.io[/url]]
